findings.summary: introduced by round 2 (M2 fix): the vanished-red subtraction was a GLOBAL count (:209,:272), so an honest fix adding one genuine red test while removing/renaming ≥1 old reds in another file was FAILED and told to 'keep the old names' (executed: 1 newly red · 2 vanished → FAILED). Reachable: environment reds exist on real bases in the replay environment (5 at b3648ac). Fixed in b267608: per-file comparison with git-mv sources mapped to head paths; pinned; global-count mutation observed red.

selftest fixture pin (:86) was vacuous vs 'support not written' — ENOENT made the test red anyway. Recast: the fixture holds the OLD greeting so the test is GREEN at base and a missing fixture flips the verdict; mutation now observed red (2 FAIL).
'every one ALREADY PASSES' printed when preExistingRed > 0 and newlyRed == 0 (old red whose body changed, name kept). Fixed: reports the already-red count; pinned.
CONVENTIONAL (:116) case-sensitive — `Fix:` → untyped → SKIPPED (honest author unarmed; also a case-change escape). Fixed: /i + lowercase.
isTestSupportFile (:80) matched src/test/ — head src files would be written into the base worktree. Fixed: never under src/.

'deleted/removed' over-claimed (a whole-file D is never baselined); a sub-50%-similarity rewrite of a red file arrives as D+A so its old reds count as new — undisclosed M2 residue (a1 class). Fixed: wording; residue disclosed in the header.
header still said runs go through npm test with lifecycle scripts; now built once + --ignore-scripts; build/prepare-only projects out of scope. Fixed in header.

a support file under test/ (setupFile, helper) changed to throw makes every replayed test red with assertions → PASSED (executed, not reachable in this repo — no vitest config); a head-added vitest.config is not written so its setupFiles do not apply at base. a1 class via support files; disclosed in the header.
srcTouched ignored D-only src changes (:239). Fixed.
